text:
[LLEX.11.1.5] Integer overflow at parse time (literal exceeds 64-bit signed
range) is a lexer error: `"integer literal out of range"`.

idris.name: lcst_4_5_8__null_spellings
idris.note: `99999999999999999999`, an integer spelling outside the 64-bit signed range, parses to `null` under `String :: Float?`, `Refl`: the clause's lexer error read as the parse's refusal.

idris.name: lcst_4_5_8__parse_float
idris.note: An integer spelling is a Float only with its signed value in the 64-bit range, as a source literal is admitted only there. Partial because the clause names a lexer error and the parse makes the spelling `null`: [LCST.4.5.8]'s 'any spelling a source literal would not admit'.
